about.photo_alt: Ben Johnson, owner of North Central Painting
about.title: Ben Johnson, owner + professional house painter
paragraphs: North Central Painting is Ben Johnson's company, licensed in Oregon since 2019 and based in Gresham.

Ben does the work himself, with the residential painting knowledge and experience to tackle your project and help transform your home. Every job comes with the same promise of quality, attention to detail, dedication and durability.
We only use top-quality materials: Sherwin-Williams, Miller Paint, Benjamin Moore, 3M, FrogTape, Purdy, Wooster and more. Call or text Ben any time.

estimate.text: Tell us about your painting project and Ben will get back to you with a free estimate.
estimate.thanks: We got your request. Ben will reach out soon about your free estimate.

services.name: Exterior Painting
services.blurb: Curb appeal that stands out in your neighborhood.
services.intro: Whether your exterior paint is failing or you're tired of the color, a new exterior makes your home stand out. If you're selling, painting is the quickest, most cost-effective way to raise its value.

services.name: Interior Painting
services.blurb: Walls, ceilings and trim, painted with care.
services.intro: From one room to the whole house, Ben brings the same attention to detail, and he'll help you pick the right shade.

services.name: Deck Refinishing
services.blurb: Decks, stairs and log homes restored and protected.
services.intro: We strip, clean and refinish decks and wood so they look better than new and hold up to the weather.

services.name: Pressure Washing
services.blurb: Wash away mold, mildew and algae.
services.intro: Here in the Northwest it rains a lot, and mold, mildew and algae thrive. Pressure washing at least twice a year is low-cost maintenance that keeps surfaces healthy.

services.name: Gutter Clean-Outs
services.blurb: Keep water off your roof and fascia.
services.intro: A thorough gutter cleaning every spring and fall keeps leaves from clogging downspouts and sending water over the sides, where it can damage your roof and fascia.
